title: bug: Hmac struct uninitialized before wc_HmacFree on SetKey failure
description: In C_Sign() HMAC path, Hmac hmac is stack-allocated but not zeroed before wc_HmacInit(). If wc_HmacSetKey() fails, wc_HmacFree() is still called unconditionally on a partially-initialized struct. On wolfCrypt implementations where HmacFree releases internal pointers, this causes a crash or heap corruption. Fix: add memset(&hmac, 0, sizeof(hmac)) before wc_HmacInit(), which is the standard wolfCrypt defensive pattern.
